environment.environment_policy: isolated-source-v3; no inherited ORQALIS/PYTHON/PYTEST/GIT overrides; no user/system Git config; process-scoped core.autocrlf=input

limits: No historical native counters: cannot retroactively prove195/663/334ms cause from one capture.
Keep all earlier unprofiled observations/tails and invalidB2252ms/2063msCPU; no subtraction or profiler repeat.
Native counters aggregate all process threads and logical/nonfileIO; not exact source-path bytes or physical disk IO.
PageFaultCount does not distinguish hard paging; working-set snapshots are boundary observations, not complete memory/RSS/peak attribution.
CPU cycles are not instructions and must never be converted to elapsed time or CPU frequency.
Host/cache/order/native runtime effects remain possible, not proven. Credible counters guide investigation, do not automatically explain historical change or grant master53 convergence.
